headline: CMS INDUSLAW advises Focus Prime on securing ₹145 crore investment; acquiring Foodexo Chennai
sum: Focus Prism Private Limited has secured a ₹145 crore investment from OAKS Asset Management, and has simultaneously acquired Foodexo Chennai Private Limited. CMS INDUSLAW advised Focus Prism and its promoter on both the transactions.
detail: Focus Prism Private Limited has secured a ₹145 crore investment from OAKS Asset Management, and has simultaneously acquired Foodexo Chennai Private Limited. CMS INDUSLAW advised Focus Prism and its promoter on both the transactions. The transaction team consisted of Rashi Bharadwaj (Partner), Shivani Singh (Principal Associate) and Rusha Ghosh Dastidar (Senior Associate), with Avimukt Dar (Founding Partner) providing strategic inputs. The corporate secretarial team comprised Ruhi Jain (Executive Director), Praveen Hedge (Manager), Adarsh Joshi (Assistant Manager) and Fhareen Abdul Aziz Khan (Executive).
